# PoliGizi Project Rules & Design System
 
## Stack & Tech
- Next.js 14+ (App Router), TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Lucide React Icons.
- Design style: Clean, Modern, Medical-Tech Dashboard (spacious padding, rounded-2xl, soft borders `border-gray-100`, shadow-sm).
 
## Design System & Colors
- Font: Plus Jakarta Sans
- Primary Color: `#00A896` (Tailwind class: `bg-primary`, `text-primary`)
- Secondary Color: `#0284C7`
- Background App: `#F9FAFB` (gray-50)
- Card Container: `bg-white border border-gray-100 rounded-2xl p-6 shadow-sm`
- Status Gizi Colors:
  - Normal: `#22C55E`
  - Stunting: `#EF4444`
  - Wasting: `#F97316`
  - Underweight: `#F59E0B`
  - Overweight: `#8B5CF6`
 
## Coding Rules
- Use TypeScript with explicit interfaces imported from `@/types`.
- Keep components modular, clean, and mobile-friendly.
- Use Lucide Icons (`lucide-react`) for all UI icons.
